S.FORM: == olit == kwohe ga sinu ana nni'un na cyolu uy. olit ga, mita' ngyaw lga, mutu kinsuruw mgyay la. olit na ksumuk hiya' ga, blaq nya' maki' talap ngasal. cipuq cikay hi' nya' ru blaq nya' balay qmihuy slaq ru hriqun nya' kwara' pinuya'.
S.PHON: olit kwoħe ɣa [s|ɕ]inu ana nniʔun na [ʦ|ʨ]jolu uj olit ɣa mitaʔ ŋjaw lɣa mutu kin[s|ɕ]uruw mɣjaj la olit na k[s|ɕ]umuk ħijaʔ ɣa βlaq njaʔ makiʔ talap ŋa[s|ɕ]al [ʦ|ʨ]ipuq [ʦ|ʨ]ikaj ħiʔ njaʔ ru βlaq njaʔ βalaj qmiħuj [s|ɕ]laq ru ħriqun njaʔ kwaraʔ pinujaʔ
